description: Use this when the user wants effect templates and the metadata needed to select an effect and create an effect task. Returns 20 effects per page by default; use page and page_size to browse, and next_page until it is null. Each effect includes a default image_url and default_music_id you can use directly. This lists templates rather than generating a video. For song-driven music, dance, or lyric videos, use generate_music_video, generate_dance_video, or generate_lyric_video.

page_size.description: Effects per page, from 1 to 100; defaults to 20.

name: list_effects

outputSchema.description: On success, returns the tool result fields. On error, returns success:false, error and code, with optional credit approval details; success-only fields are absent.

effects.description: Supported effects with the metadata needed to create an effect task.

default_music_id.description: Default music ID to pass to generate_effect.music_id.

image_url.description: Default cover image URL for generate_effect.reference_image_urls[0]. You may also replace it with a single uploaded image URL from upload_image.

preview_video_url.description: Preview video URL for the effect.

message.description: A human-readable summary of the retrieved effects.

next_page.description: Next page number, or null when no further effects are available.

page_size.description: Requested maximum number of effects per page.

anyOf.description: Whether the effects list was retrieved successfully.

total.description: Total number of supported effects across all pages.
